manage_schedules_team_desc: One schedule sets the whole tagma's work window: the root agent wakes on start, delegates to subagents, and buffers messages while off duty.
manage_schedules_monthly_short_note: Days a shorter month lacks simply do not fire (Feb has no 30th/31st).
manage_schedules_overnight: Runs past midnight into the next day.
manage_schedules_zero_window: Start and end are the same time; the window never opens.
manage_schedules_windows_label: Daily windows (each fires on every selected day)
manage_schedules_error_overlap: Windows overlap on the absolute timeline; adjust them
manage_schedules_always_note: On duty around the clock — no days, no windows.
manage_schedules_monthly_utc_note: Monthly day numbers are edited in UTC: crossing month borders is lossy (months differ in length), so this clock stays locked.
manage_schedules_switch_blocked: The clock can't switch while the draft has no exact equivalent in the other clock.
manage_schedules_unrepresentable: A full-day window on picked days has no exact equivalent in this clock; shorten the window, switch to the 24/7 mode, or discard.
manage_schedules_anchor_note: Saving after changing N or L restarts the rotation from save time; toggling only the switch or other fields keeps its phase.
manage_schedules_dst_note: Stored aligned to UTC; on DST transition days the local wall time shifts by an hour.
manage_schedules_final_warn_hint: Sent at the final warning; empty uses the default. {N} expands to the minutes left.
manage_schedules_warn_invalid: warn minutes must be valid numbers
manage_schedules_wake_hint: Sent to the root agent when the shift starts; it delegates to the team.
manage_schedules_error_length_min: L must be 1 minute to 7 days
